title: Protocol for the generation of human induced hepatic stem cells using Sendai virus vectors
protocol: Wash human hepatocytes twice with 10 mL of phosphate buffered saline (PBS) on Day -1.
Dissociate the cells with 0.05% trypsin/EDTA for 5 min.
Add 5 ml of hepatocyte basal medium and break up cell aggregates by pipetting up and down with a 5 ml pipette.
Centrifuge the samples at 700 × g for 5 min to pellet the cells.
Remove the supernatant.
Count cells and dilute to 1.0 × 10^5 cells/mL in hepatocyte basal medium.
Plate cells (1.0 × 10^5 cells/well) in 6-well plates.
Incubate human hepatocytes at 37°C, 5% CO2, and 85% humidity for 24 h.
Prepare a 15 ml tube containing 2 mL of hepatocyte basal medium with 10 μL of SeV KOS (5.0 × 10^5 CIU), 10 μL of SeV Klf4 (5.0 × 10^5 CIU), and 10 μL of SeV Myc (5.0 × 10^5 CIU) on Day 0.
Aspirate the culture medium.
Add 2 mL hepatocyte basal medium with SeV.
Place the 6-well plate in an incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2, and 85% humidity for 24 h.
On Day 1, aspirate the culture medium.
Renew with fresh hepatocyte basal medium.
Repeat daily for 3 days.
On Day 4, dissociate the hepatocytes.
Plate the hepatocytes in a 60 mm dish containing MEFs using human ES/iPS/iTS-L cell culture medium.
Place the 60 mm dish in an incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2, and 85% humidity.
Change human ES/iPS/iTS-L cell culture medium daily.
On Days 14–21, observe for round morphology transformation of reprogrammed cells.
Independently expand every single clone for characterization and freezing.
Anesthetize immunodeficient male mice with isoflurane inhalation.
Inject 1.0 × 10^6 cells in 0.1 mL of cold Hanks' balanced salt solution subcutaneously into the shoulders and buttocks using a 22 G injection needle.
Examine the mice daily for tumor formation.
Extract tumors at 10 or 15 weeks after surgery.
Culture iPS/iTS-L cells to approximately 80% confluence in Primate ES Cell Medium.
Prepare RNA from the iPS/iTS-L cells using a SuperPREP II Cell Lysis & RT Kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
